figures.shows: The list of the tests labelled core in the Debug configuration, one line per shard, without running them
figures.caption: Each numbered line is one shard of the test program as CTest knows it, and the last line counts them. A mark at the start of a line stands for a warning cut out: the build that made this list holds no test program.
figures.alt: A numbered list of thirteen test names that start with the same prefix and end in the name of a shard, followed by a line with the total number of tests.
